signal.background: NEMA 12-region ROI set x 5 slices (60 ROIs)
signal.lung_insert: low-density cylindrical insert, standard NEMA geometry

location.note: sphere centres and diameters are known by construction (physical phantom geometry); VOI placement in reconstructed volumes uses the released ground_truth.json geometry

task_definition.primary_endpoint: NEMA NU-2 percent contrast recovery (Q_H / Q_C) per sphere, against physical ground truth
task_definition.explicitly_not_answered: task detectability (AUC / CHO / NPWE-style observer studies) is NOT reported from this dataset; contrast recovery describes signal fidelity, not a decision task. See TASK_DEFINITION.md §Observer plan.

observer.plan: numeric image-quality metrics per NEMA NU 2-2018; NO reader panel, NO channelized-observer detectability experiment in 1.0

metrics.bland_altman: decayed vs thinned: bias + 95% limits of agreement
metrics.across_realization_stats: mean + population variance across seeded thinned realizations

protocol.decayed_series: physical acquisitions across tracer decay at each r (same fill/geometry)
protocol.thinned_series: seeded list-mode Poisson thinning (series_id, r, realization_index) from full-count reference
protocol.reconstruction: single fixed protocol for all series (eliminates recon as confound)
protocol.ground_truth: ground_truth.json: measured fill concentrations, true contrasts, NEMA ROI geometry

low_activity_to_dose_mapping.relation: r = A_red / A_ref (injected-activity ratio), same frame duration => same relative dose; low-activity series ARE dose-fraction series
low_activity_to_dose_mapping.decayed_series: physical A_red achieved by tracer decay between scans (measured by dose calibrator, decay-corrected)
low_activity_to_dose_mapping.thinned_series: statistical realization of r x reference counts (models the same dose fraction under the Poisson channel)
low_activity_to_dose_mapping.twin_link: r here is exactly the WS-2 PET T_r signal-reduction level; decayed-vs-thinned agreement measures the thinning-model error (WS-2 theory/proofs/twin_validity_domain.md)
low_activity_to_dose_mapping.not_claimed: activity-dependent detector physics (dead-time, pile-up, randoms fraction) are NOT modelled by thinning; the decayed series measures that discrepancy

source_of_truth: analysis/TASK_DEFINITION.md (human-readable), analysis/nema_metrics.py (implementation); this file is the machine-readable mirror aligned with WS-1_dataset/baselines/task_spec.json
